term: raised from the dead by an agent (Raising.RaisedBy)
definition: `RaisedBy g x`: g raised x from the dead; an agent's act, not merely the event that x rose (`RoseFromTheDead`). Example: in the Acts 2 speech, God raised Jesus. Counterexample: an anomalous revival with no agent. Distinguished from confirmation (`Agency.Confirms`), which is a testimonial act; that raising confirms is an open premise (STMT-RAISING-A-CLAIMANT-CONFIRMS-HIS-MANDATE). No structural properties are assumed.
note: Analyst vocabulary. NT-ACTS-2-22-36-RESURRECTION-MAKES-KNOWN-LORD-AND-CHRIST reports God raising Jesus; it does not define the relation.
